What Is Foot Reflexology?

Foot reflexology is a focused treatment using pressure on areas of the feet. At Fall Health Spa, the session is centered on comfort, tired feet and relaxation.

Foot reflexology in Bellevue

This service is a focused foot treatment rather than a full-body massage. Pressure is adjusted around sensitivity, and guests should mention foot injuries or health concerns before treatment.

For full-body relaxation, explore Swedish massage, or browse all services.

Frequently Asked Questions

Is reflexology the same as a foot massage?

They overlap, but they are not identical. Reflexology uses focused pressure patterns, while a general foot massage may concentrate more broadly on muscles and soft tissue.

Can pressure be adjusted?

Yes. Tell your therapist about sensitive areas and the pressure that feels comfortable.

Should I mention foot problems before treatment?

Yes. Share recent injuries, pain, skin concerns or other health conditions so the therapist can discuss whether treatment is appropriate.
